name: Creatomate
summary: Template-based video and image rendering: fill a stored template's dynamic fields per render through the REST API.

api_key.description: a Creatomate project API key (Project Settings > API). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Rate limit: 30 requests per 10 seconds per account, across all its projects; a 429 carries Retry-After in seconds.
Errors carry a hint field written to explain the fix; 402 means out of credits.
Free plan output is clamped to 480 px on both sides.
Template create/update/delete (writes) and the v1 batch render-by-tags call are not in this entry. Request bodies are capped at 2 MB.

endpoints.name: Render a template
endpoints.summary: Renders a video or image from a stored template with modifications (or from raw RenderScript); dry_run validates for free.

template_id.description: Template id (editor: Use Template > Developer API).

modifications.description: Element name to new value, e.g. {"Title-1": "Your headline", "Background-1": "https://...mp4"}.

dry_run.description: true validates only: 200 with valid, errors, warnings and the effective RenderScript; no credits, nothing queued.

render_scale.description: Scale factor for the output; 0.5 costs about a quarter.

metadata.description: Free text echoed back on the render.

webhook_url.description: URL called when the render completes, instead of polling.

notes: Spends credits unless dry_run: an image is 1 credit; a video is width x height x fps x seconds / 100,000,000, rounded up.
202 with one render object; read its errors and warnings arrays (a modification that matched no element is a warning, not a failure).
Poll creatomate.renders.get until status is succeeded or failed.

endpoints.name: Get a render
endpoints.summary: Status and, when succeeded, the output file URL.
notes: status runs planned, waiting, transcribing, rendering, then succeeded (url is the file) or failed (read error_message).
Renders and their files are deleted 30 days after creation.

endpoints.name: List templates
endpoints.summary: The project's templates, compact (no RenderScript source).

endpoints.name: Get a template
endpoints.summary: One template with its full RenderScript source, to see element names for modifications.

endpoints.name: Get a feed's last rows
endpoints.summary: A sample of a feed: its last rows.
